text: 中国银行公告，为深入贯彻落实党中央、国务院有关决策部署，支持城乡居民刚性住房需求，切实减轻符合条件购房家庭的利息负担，中国银行积极落实《关于实施居民购房贷款贴息政策的通知》（财金〔2026〕95号）精神及相关要求，自2026年10月1日起，针对符合政策条件的商业性个人住房贷款开展财政贴息工作，确保政策红利惠及广大消费者。同时，将优化办理流程，简化办理手续。
text_en: Bank of China announced that, in order to thoroughly implement the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, support the rigid housing demand of urban and rural residents, and effectively reduce the interest burden on eligible homebuying families, Bank of China is actively implementing the spirit and relevant requirements of the Notice on Implementing the Interest Subsidy Policy for Resident Home Purchase Loans (Caijin [2026] No. 95). Starting October 1, 2026, it will carry out fiscal interest subsidy work for eligible commercial personal housing loans to ensure that the policy benefits reach consumers broadly. At the same time, it will optimize processing procedures and simplify handling formalities.
